top_choice_rationale: P005 recognises a new concept of molecular organisation: liquid-liquid demixing of multivalent biomolecules, governed by classical phase equilibria, valency and concentration thresholds, organises cells without membranes. Brangwynne and Hyman (P granules, 2009) and Rosen (multivalent signalling proteins, reconstituted quantitatively) give a clean three-name allocation, and after about fifteen years the principle is independently reproduced. In vivo functional necessity of condensates is still debated, which is why this is a close call, but a concept prize in physical chemistry is stronger than a tool or a platform refinement. P001 is second as the most chemically new and broadly confirmed alternative, though the Handa/Ciulli third seat and the one-versus-two-lineages citation are unsettled. P003 ranks above P002 because the evolved adenine editor is a new capability, but both sit close to an already recognised paradigm (CRISPR-Cas9 in 2020; Pd cross-coupling in 2010). P004 is a real but diffuse and long-established field. A prize is still preferable to no award.
recusal_note: No personal or institutional tie to any credited name on the slate is apparent from my profile. Scientific proximity only: condensates touch the lipid-protein and soft-matter assembly work in my group, and I am a Lund colleague of Heiner Linke and Peter Somfai, which is not a conflict with any credited candidate.
